description: This header file defines functions related to URL parsing within the lighttpd web server project. It declares functions for parsing raw URLs, paths, and hostnames into a request URI structure.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_url
methods.description: Parses the raw URL into its components within a request URI object; this must be reset or initialized before calling.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_path
methods.description: Parses raw input into the URI's path, raw_path, and query components, decoding and simplifying the path if successful.

methods.name: li_parse_hostname
methods.description: Extracts hostname information from the URI object.
